instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees. Place hands on hips.
2. Shift your weight onto your right leg and lift your left foot slightly off the floor.
3. Keeping the left leg straight, lift it out to the side against the band, squeezing the outer hip at the top.
4. Lower the leg back to the start with control.
5. Finish all reps, then switch to the other leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you lift the leg and inhale as you lower it.
2. Keep a slight bend in the standing leg to stay balanced.
3. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning to the side.
4. Move slowly and avoid swinging the leg.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a loop band around both wrists.
2. Bend your elbows to 90 degrees and tuck them against your sides, forearms pointing forward.
3. Rotate your forearms outward, pulling the band apart while keeping the elbows pinned.
4. Return your forearms to the start with control, keeping tension on the band. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly to maximise rotator cuff activation and protect the shoulder.
2. Exhale as you rotate out, inhale as you return.
3. Keep the elbows fixed at your sides throughout.
4. Use a light band so form stays clean.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
2. Bend your hips and knees into a half-squat, keeping your back straight and chest slightly forward.
3. Press your knees outward against the band, opening the legs as wide as possible.
4. Bring your knees back together with control, keeping tension on the band.
5. Hold the half-squat throughout. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you press the knees out, inhale as you bring them in.
2. Use a band with enough tension to challenge you without breaking form.
3. Keep feet flat and weight evenly distributed.
4. Drive the knees out from the hips, not the feet.

instructions:
1. Anchor a band at hip height and stand facing the anchor, holding the free end in your right hand.
2. Reach your right arm forward toward the anchor, palm facing down.
3. Keeping the arm straight, pull the band down and back until your hand reaches your side.
4. Return your arm forward to the start with control.
5. Finish all reps, then switch arms. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement from your lat and rear shoulder, not your hand.
2. Keep a slight bend in the elbow to protect the joint.
3. Keep the band taut throughout the set.
4. Stay tall and avoid leaning back.

instructions:
1. Anchor a band at hip height and stand with your back to the anchor, holding the free end in your right hand.
2. Let your right arm hang back toward the anchor, palm facing forward.
3. Keeping the arm straight, raise it forward and up to about lower-chest height.
4. Lower your arm back to the start with control.
5. Finish all reps, then switch arms. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement from the front of your shoulder.
2. Keep a slight bend in the elbow to protect the joint.
3. Keep the band taut throughout the set.
4. Stay tall and brace your core to avoid arching.
